author: Aetheria I
title: Hybrid Residual CNN with Transformer Encoder and Global Average Pooling
abstract: This submission proposes a hybrid architecture combining residual 1D CNN blocks with a Transformer Encoder block. The CNNs are first used to extract local sequence features. Subsequently, a Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) layer and a Feed-Forward Network (FFN) within a Transformer Encoder block process these features to capture long-range dependencies. This aims to overcome limitations of purely local feature extraction and simplistic global pooling. The output from the Transformer Encoder is then subjected to Global Average Pooling before being fed into an MLP head for task-specific predictions.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from jax import random
from typing import Dict, Any, Tuple, Optional

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define custom hyperparameters for the Hybrid Residual CNN with Transformer Encoder model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'num_cnn_blocks': 3,
        'num_cnn_filters': 256,
        'cnn_kernel_size': 5,
        'transformer_num_heads': 4,
        'transformer_ff_dim': 512, # 2 * num_cnn_filters
        'mlp_hidden_dim': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1
    }

class ResidualCNNBlock(nn.Module):
    """A residual block composed of 1D CNN layers."""
    features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        residual = x

        # First convolution
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second convolution
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Ensure residual connection matches dimensions (if features changed)
        if residual.shape[-1] != self.features:
            residual = nn.Dense(self.features)(residual)

        return nn.relu(x + residual)

class MultiHeadSelfAttention(nn.Module):
    """Multi-head self-attention layer."""
    num_heads: int
    features_per_head: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, total_features)
        total_features = x.shape[-1]
        assert total_features == self.num_heads * self.features_per_head

        query = nn.Dense(total_features, name="query_proj")(x)
        key = nn.Dense(total_features, name="key_proj")(x)
        value = nn.Dense(total_features, name="value_proj")(x)

        # Reshape to (batch, num_heads, seq_len, features_per_head)
        query = query.reshape(x.shape[0], x.shape[1], self.num_heads, self.features_per_head).transpose((0, 2, 1, 3))
        key = key.reshape(x.shape[0], x.shape[1], self.num_heads, self.features_per_head).transpose((0, 2, 1, 3))
        value = value.reshape(x.shape[0], x.shape[1], self.num_heads, self.features_per_head).transpose((0, 2, 1, 3))

        # Compute attention scores
        # (batch, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len)
        attention_scores = jnp.matmul(query, key.transpose((0, 1, 3, 2))) / jnp.sqrt(self.features_per_head)

        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_scores, axis=-1)
        attention_weights = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attention_weights, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Apply attention weights to values
        # (batch, num_heads, seq_len, features_per_head)
        attended_output = jnp.matmul(attention_weights, value)

        # Reshape back to original (batch, seq_len, total_features)
        attended_output = attended_output.transpose((0, 2, 1, 3)).reshape(x.shape[0], x.shape[1], total_features)

        return attended_output

class TransformerEncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    """A single Transformer Encoder block."""
    embed_dim: int # Input feature dimension
    num_heads: int
    ff_dim: int # Feed-forward network hidden dimension
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # LayerNorm before attention
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)

        # Multi-head self-attention
        attended_x = MultiHeadSelfAttention(num_heads=self.num_heads,
                                          features_per_head=self.embed_dim // self.num_heads,
                                          dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                                          name="multi_head_attention")(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        attended_x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attended_x, deterministic=deterministic)
        # Add residual connection
        x = x + attended_x

        # LayerNorm before FFN
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)

        # Feed-forward network
        ffn_x = nn.Dense(self.ff_dim)(x)
        ffn_x = nn.relu(ffn_x)
        ffn_x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(ffn_x, deterministic=deterministic)
        ffn_x = nn.Dense(self.embed_dim)(ffn_x) # Project back to embed_dim
        ffn_x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(ffn_x, deterministic=deterministic)
        # Add residual connection
        x = x + ffn_x

        return x

class HybridCNNTransformerNetworkModule(nn.Module):
    """
    Hybrid architecture combining Multi-Layer Residual CNN with a Transformer Encoder block
    and Global Average Pooling for RNA sequence prediction.
    """
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    num_cnn_blocks: int
    num_cnn_filters: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    transformer_num_heads: int
    transformer_ff_dim: int
    mlp_hidden_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, d_input=4)

        # Initial projection to the desired filter dimension
        x = nn.Dense(self.num_cnn_filters)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Stack Residual CNN Blocks
        for i in range(self.num_cnn_blocks):
            x = ResidualCNNBlock(features=self.num_cnn_filters,
                                 kernel_size=self.cnn_kernel_size,
                                 dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                                 name=f"residual_cnn_block_{i}")(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Apply Transformer Encoder Block
        x = TransformerEncoderBlock(embed_dim=self.num_cnn_filters,
                                    num_heads=self.transformer_num_heads,
                                    ff_dim=self.transformer_ff_dim,
                                    dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                                    name="transformer_encoder_block")(x, deterministic=deterministic)


        # Global Average Pooling across the sequence length
        x = jnp.mean(x, axis=1) # (batch, num_cnn_filters)

        # Final dense layers for task adaptation (MLP head)
        x = nn.Dense(self.mlp_hidden_dim)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Output layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x)

        # Handle output squeezing for single-output regression tasks
        if self.task_type == "regression": # APA, CRI-Off, CRI-On, MRL
            return x.squeeze(-1) # Output (batch,)
        else: # Modif, PRS, ncRNA
            return x # Output (batch, d_output)

class CustomRNANetworkWrapper:
    """Wrapper to match the required network interface."""

    def __init__(self, hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
        self.network = HybridCNNTransformerNetworkModule(
            d_output=hparams['d_output'],
            task_type=hparams['task_type'],
            num_cnn_blocks=hparams['num_cnn_blocks'],
            num_cnn_filters=hparams['num_cnn_filters'],
            cnn_kernel_size=hparams['cnn_kernel_size'],
            transformer_num_heads=hparams['transformer_num_heads'],
            transformer_ff_dim=hparams['transformer_ff_dim'],
            mlp_hidden_dim=hparams['mlp_hidden_dim'],
            dropout_rate=hparams['dropout_rate']
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """
    Create and return the custom RNA network based on HybridCNNTransformerNetworkModule.
    This function will be called by the system.
    """
    return CustomRNANetworkWrapper(hparams)
